name: mode
label: Mode
description: Available items population method

name: viewType
label: View type
description: Configure how to display the component, compact / two Panels (available and selected) / dot walk view (split available on dot walk)

name: tableName
label: Table Name
description: Table from where the fields needs to be displayed, only applicable to Connected mode

name: allowDotWalking
label: Allow Dot Walking
description: If true, a tree is displayed to select from, that includes reference fields so we can dot-walk, only applicable to Connected mode

name: showVariables
label: Show Variables
description: If this flag set to true, list selector will display variables and questions in available items

name: showExtendedFields
label: Show extended fields
description: If this flag set to true, list selector will display extended fields in available items. To align list selector with legacy dot-walking components showExtendedFields value should be bound to glide.ui.list.allow_extended_fields

name: includeSysId
label: Include System Id
description: Flag to include sysId in list of fields shown, only applicable to Connected mode

name: itemsRoot
label: Items Root
description: The root panel to be opened when component opens, only applicable to Manual mode

name: items
label: Items
description: Items object for manual population of available items, only applicable to Manual mode

name: selectedItems
label: Selected Items
description: selectedItems - list of selected fields

name: unselectableItems
label: Unselectable items
description: Items that are not selectable

name: availableLabel
label: Available bucket label
description: A label for the available columns

name: selectedLabel
label: Selected bucket label
description: A label for the selected columns

name: showCount
label: Show count
description: Show the number of items in selected and available buckets

name: headersLevel
label: Headers level
description: Specifies the list selector available and selected headings level (H1-H6) it does not effect title design

name: disableReorder
label: Disable reorder of selected items
description: Disable reorder of seleted items

name: showSelectedItemPath
label: Show selected item path
description: Open selected item path in available bucket, when clicked

name: showHiddenControls
label: Always show hidden controls
description: Some controls may be hidden until the relevant element is hovered or focused. This setting reveals all hidden controls inside the component.

name: search
label: Search behavior
description: Controls how to filter the list items as the user types into the integrated search input

name: hideResetWarning
label: Hide reset warning message
description: Hide reset warning message when list selector data reset after tableName/itemsRoot changed.
